row: Towcester Veterinary Centre is a busy, rural veterinary practice in the south east of England. We have a small animal and large animal department based in Towcester and a separate equine clinic situated at Plum park Farm, Paulerspury. We pride our selves on a high standard of care. The video's posted here are a record of the interesting and challenging cases we  have seen and treated in each of our departments.
